text:
sophia: quick note 1: onboarding mariner-8b (hf->redwood int8) stalled on staging. prompt-suite BLEU and long-context recall both drop vs fp16.
noah: numbers? single-sentence vs long-context?
sophia: short: BLEU fp16 28.4 -> int8 17.1. longctx retrieval recall@1 fp16 82% -> int8 49%.
liam: yikes. sounds like a positional interpolation or KV-index shift — did the exporter include a `position_scale`/`rotary_freq` map? mariner uses fractional rotary scaling in the checkpoint.
ciara: converter currently sets rotary_freq = base * (head_dim/2)**-0.5 by default. if mariner used a custom schedule (freqs * 0.75), that could explain amplitude mismatch for long ranges.
sophia: I inspected model.json: there's a tensor `rotary_alpha` with values ~0.75 in some heads. converter ignored it (legacy field).
noah: ahhh. that would make rotary angles too large => aliasing across tokens, hurting longctx. can we patch conversion to read `rotary_alpha` and apply per-head scaling when building sin/cos tables?
liam: quick hack I ran locally: after conversion I overwrote sin/cos generation with:
```
# patch: apply per-head alpha from metadata
for h in range(num_heads):
  alpha = meta.get(f"rotary_alpha_{h}", 1.0)
  freqs[h] *= alpha
  sin_table[h] = np.sin(freqs[h] * positions)
  cos_table[h] = np.cos(freqs[h] * positions)
```
# eval snippet
python eval/eval_suite.py --model converted_mariner.bin --suite longctx --max_pos 8192
```
liam: result: recall@1 recovered to 79% and BLEU to 27.6.
ciara: nice. next: tokenizer oddities — sophia, you mentioned some token-level off-by-one earlier?
sophia: yes. mariner's tokenizer uses a ZWNJ (0x200C) to separate certain suffixes; HF tokenizer normalizes that away when `use_fast=True`. our conversion kept the raw vocab mapping so token IDs differ when `use_fast` toggles. that caused misaligned KV indices for fwd vs cached replay.
noah: so two problems: (A) rotary_alpha ignored; (B) tokenizer normalization mismatch leads to token ID shadowing. both together explain the BLEU/recall collapse.
ciara: mitigation plan: (1) convert should import `rotary_alpha*` metadata and embed per-head alpha into artifact; (2) add token-normalizer step in convert pipeline (NFKC + ZWNJ-aware folding) and emit `tokenizer_mode` metadata (fast|slow|normalize). (3) add regression test: run short/long suites and assert delta < 3% vs FP16.
sophia: created RED-901 with repro and patch suggestion. will open a PR for conversion changes. target: small fix today, full regression run tomorrow.
deploy-bot: deploy queued: staging/convert-service v2.14 -> running smoke tests.
liam: one more note: KV-cache indexing when tokenizer normalization changes can shift cached offsets by a leading-token change. add a warning in Console when `tokenizer_mode` differs between model and request client.
sophia: agreed. I'll add metadata keys: `rotary_alpha_present` (bool), `tokenizer_mode`, `tokenizer_hash`. putting full logs in the ticket.
noah: thanks. ping when PR is up and I'll run the 6-benchmark cluster overnight.
